'''Eedund Cus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]]. Some time after [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Cus purchased [[Lobar Aybock]] from [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] in order to train him as a [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxer]]. Aside from teaching Aybock the art of shockboxing, Cus also taught the [[Calian]] to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and understand [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]].

He referred to himself as 'an unrepentant [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]' and put no faith in [[Droid/Legends|droids]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
According to author [[Edward M. Erdelac]], the name Eedund Cus came from combining a [[tuckerization]] of the surname of [[Wikipedia:Angelo Dundee|Angelo Dundee]]&mdash;[[Wikipedia:Muhammad Ali|Muhammad Ali's]] [[Wikipedia:Boxing|boxing]] [[Wikipedia:Cornerman|cornerman]]&mdash;with the first name of [[Wikipedia:Mike Tyson|Mike Tyson's]] trainer, [[Wikipedia:Cus D'Amato|Cus D'Amato]].
